mapper.update: UPDATE time_table SET yy = #{dto.yy}, mm = #{dto.mm}, dayname = #{dto.dayname}, period_no = #{dto.periodNo}, start_time = #{dto.startTime}, end_time = #{dto.endTime}, class_no = #{dto.classNo}, unit_no = #{dto.unitNo}, grade_no = #{dto.gradeNo}, user_no = #{dto.userNo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE time_table_no = #{timeTableNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT time_table_no AS timeTableNo, period_no AS periodNo, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, yy AS yy, mm AS mm, dayname AS dayname, tt.class_no AS classNo, tt.unit_no AS unitNo, grade_no AS gradeNo, cc.class_type AS classType, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_code AS unitCode FROM time_table tt JOIN class_code cc ON tt.class_no = cc.class_no JOIN unit_code uc ON tt.unit_no = uc.unit_no
WHERE yy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY dayname, period_no

SELECT st.student_no AS studentNo, st.student_name AS studentName, tta.time_table_assign_no AS time_table_assign_no FROM time_table_assign tta JOIN student_tb st ON tta.student_no = st.student_no WHERE tta.time_table_no = #{timeTableNo} ORDER BY st.student_name

SELECT tt.time_table_no as timeTableNo, tt.period_no as periodNo, tt.start_time as startTime, tt.end_time as endTime, tt.yy as yy, tt.mm as mm, tt.dayname as dayname, cc.class_no as classNo, cc.class_name as subject, uc.unit_no as unitNo, uc.unit_code as unitCode, g.grade_no as gradeNo, g.grade as gradeCode FROM TIME_TABLE tt JOIN grade_code g ON tt.grade_no = g.grade_no JOIN class_code cc ON tt.class_no = cc.class_no JOIN unit_code uc ON tt.unit_no = uc.unit_no JOIN user_tb u ON tt.user_no = u.user_no WHERE tt.yy = #{year} and tt.mm = #{month} and tt.period_no = #{periodNo} and tt.dayname = #{dayname}
